text.arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ

words.gloss_range: emphatic oath-answer lām prefixed to the confirming particle, front-loading the clause as sworn assertion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: certainty particle joined with the opening lām
combined emphatic opening formed by the lām and certainty particle

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) makes the verse open as the answer to the oath sequence rather than as a neutral report. Because it is prefixed directly to {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), the reader first receives the compact force of {{ar:لَقَدْ}} ({{tr:laqad}}): the claim about human creation is framed as asserted content after 95:1-3. The particle also delays the creative verb by one beat, so certainty and oath-resolution arrive before the act of creation is named. Its short onset helps make the clause snap from suspended oath into declaration.

topics.headline: lām marks the sworn answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 95:4 as the proposition for which the preceding oath sequence has been preparing them.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as emphatic, and attachment evidence says the clause introduced by {{ar:لَقَدْ}} ({{tr:laqad}}) follows the oath sequence as its asserted response.

topics.headline: bound opener creates a compact emphatic launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears assertion-force before the verb, so the act of creation enters under certainty rather than opening the clause by itself.
topics.reason: The surface places {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) immediately before {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) and before the verb, matching the CRITICAL claim that the emphatic compound launches the assertion.

topics.headline: short particle resolves the boundary audibly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a very small opener carries multiple jobs: scope, oath-resolution, and declarative mode.
topics.reason: No guardrail contradicts the row's local observation that the clipped opener contributes to the compact boundary from oath to assertion.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle with a perfect verb, confirming the completed act rather than marking mere possibility

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: perfect verb governed by the certainty particle
prefixed emphatic lām forming the opening assertion cluster
combined emphatic opening formed by the lām and certainty particle

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) confirms the completed act carried by {{ar:خَلَقْنَا}} ({{tr:khalaqnā}}). With a perfect verb, the particle does not suggest possibility; it makes the creation claim arrive as realized fact. Joined after {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), it gives the opening a doubled assertion before the predicate appears, so the reader receives verification and completion before the act itself. The hard close of the particle also fits the decisive texture of the oath answer.

topics.headline: qad confirms the completed perfect verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the creation claim as assured completed reality, not as a bare past event or a possible occurrence.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) as a certainty particle with the perfect verb {{ar:خَلَقْنَا}} ({{tr:khalaqnā}}), which supports taḥqīq rather than the weaker imperfect-verb possibility use.

topics.headline: lām plus qad stack assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause is calibrated as maximally asserted after the oath, not merely informative.
topics.reason: The adjacent particles form {{ar:لَقَدْ}} ({{tr:laqad}}), and attachment translation support says the combined opening should preserve surface emphasis.

topics.headline: verification arrives before the action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the ayah's opening as verification first and creation second.
topics.reason: The particle precedes the verb in the local word order, and the sound observation is a local stylistic payoff rather than a claim about grammar.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person plural act of creating, with direct divine agency and measured/proportioned making selected by the local object and final quality phrase
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range including measuring, creating, forming, character, fitness, fabrication, and leveling; the local perfect verb selects divine creation with proportioning pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: explicit direct object of the creation verb
state or setting complement specifying the result as best constitution

words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقْنَا}} ({{tr:khalaqnā}}) presents creation as a completed divine act with the subject carried inside the verb. The first-person plural suffix makes the speaker present without adding a separate subject noun, while the active perfect keeps agency compact and direct. The root's measuring and proportioning range matters here because the verb takes {{ar:ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ}} ({{tr:al-insān}}) as explicit object and then resolves into {{ar:فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:fī aḥsani taqwīmin}}); creation is not bare origination but making by measured constitution. The fabricated-speech branch remains a controlled contrast to authentic creation, while the smoothing or evening branch survives only as craftsmanship pressure: the human is made even, proportioned, and set right. The same human-creation formula appears elsewhere with different specifications (15:26; 23:12; 55:3), while this ayah specializes it through the best-constitution tail and then faces reversal in 95:5.

topics.headline: perfect verb carries compact divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the creation claim as a completed act whose divine subject is encoded inside the verb itself.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:خَلَقْنَا}} ({{tr:khalaqnā}}) as a perfect first-person plural verb with an implicit subject carried by agreement.

topics.headline: creation is measured toward constitution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that creation here is shaped as proportioned making, because the verb is completed by the final constitution phrase.
topics.reason: V4 supports measuring, originating, and complete formation as accepted branches, but the local perfect verb with explicit object and {{ar:فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:fī aḥsani taqwīmin}}) selects proportioned creation rather than activating every root branch.

topics.headline: fabrication branch stays contrastive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the authentic-creation claim against the root's counterfeit and leveling branches while keeping divine creation as the selected sense.
topics.reason: V4 recognizes fabricated speech and leveling branches, but the local frame names divine creation of humanity; those branches can only provide contrast or texture, not replace the active sense.

topics.headline: active Form I keeps agency direct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word does not suppress the maker or shift to a derived causative frame; speaker and act are fused in one active verb.
topics.reason: The local morphology is active Form I perfect with a first-person plural suffix, not passive or derived-form wording.

topics.headline: familiar human-creation formula gets a unique tail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a familiar creation-of-human construction while seeing this occurrence sharpened by the final phrase of excellence and constitution.
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows the root often takes direct objects and commonly has God as referent, while the CRITICAL rows cite human-creation parallels (15:26; 23:12; 55:3).

topics.headline: creation points toward the next reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the completed act in 95:4 as the first half of a formation-to-reversal movement that continues in 95:5.
topics.reason: Attachment support links the object of 95:4 to the suffix in 95:5, and the CRITICAL rows explicitly connect the creation verb with the following return verb (95:5).

topics.headline: the verb turns oath setting into declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the move from sworn setting into direct divine declaration, with the weight of the verb carrying that turn.
topics.reason: The finite verb opens the propositional core after the particle cluster; the sound and boundary rows describe local rhetorical effects that are not contradicted by grammar.

words.gloss_range: generic definite human as direct object of creation, compressed into a singular species term and carried forward into the next ayah
words.root_gloss_range: human noun field centered on sociability and perception, with a contested forgetfulness derivation kept as etymological pressure rather than replacing the local root

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: creation verb of which the human noun is direct object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ}} ({{tr:al-insān}}) names humanity as a generic definite object: the verse is not about one specimen but about the human creature as such. Its accusative role makes humanity the patient of {{ar:خَلَقْنَا}} ({{tr:khalaqnā}}), and the singular form compresses the species into one representative noun before the quality phrase defines its condition. The {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) field lets the object be heard as a perceiving and social creature, while the contested forgetfulness derivation is only a narrowed etymological pressure because the local root alignment is {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}). As a frequent Quran-wide human protagonist, this noun carries the same creature who can be praised here and critiqued in the following descent. The same referent is then picked up in the descent of 95:5 and divided by the exception in 95:6, so the praised object here already carries the forward risk of reversal.

topics.headline: generic definite universalizes the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the claim addressed to the human species in a singular representative form, not to a named individual.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as definite with generic reference, and contextual profiles list HUMANS_GENERIC as the dominant referent.

topics.headline: humanity receives the creative act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees humanity first as the received object of creation before the final phrase specifies its created state.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly identifies {{ar:ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ}} ({{tr:al-insān}}) as the direct object of {{ar:خَلَقْنَا}} ({{tr:khalaqnā}}).

topics.headline: root image adds relational capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the created object can be heard as a perceiving and social being, not merely biological matter.
topics.reason: The local alignment gives root {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}); V4 has no root rows for this root, so the CRITICAL root image is preserved cautiously rather than expanded beyond the local noun.

topics.headline: contested forgetfulness derivation remains pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense a tension in the human designation that helps the next ayah's reversal feel internally possible.
topics.reason: The prompt allows contested derivations to survive when useful, but QAC aligns the local root as {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}), so forgetfulness is kept as etymological pressure rather than the selected root.

topics.headline: familiar human noun is specialized here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the Quran-wide human protagonist in a familiar creation frame, now sharpened by the best-constitution phrase.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence supports high frequency and generic human reference, while the local syntax pairs the noun directly with the creation verb.

topics.headline: object becomes the next referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the praised human of 95:4 into the pronoun and reversal of 95:5, then toward the exception in 95:6.
topics.reason: Attachment support says the object in 95:4 is resumed by the suffix in 95:5 and narrowed by the exception in 95:6.

topics.headline: glottal onset marks the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the human object emerge as a distinct target after the flowing article.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is a local surface observation and does not conflict with the grammatical object analysis.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the best-constitution phrase as the state or setting of the creation event, with controlled containment/inherence pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: genitive complement governed by the preposition
creation verb to which the state phrase attaches

words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns the final phrase into the condition or setting of creation. It governs {{ar:أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:aḥsani taqwīmin}}), so the best constitution is not a detached second object or a later add-on; it belongs inside the creation assertion. The preposition can leave a controlled pressure between being created within best form and being created as best-formed, but the attachment evidence keeps both readings within the state phrase. Its position after creator, act, and object makes the ayah pivot from the act of creating to the quality of the created state. The long vowel flows into the hamza-opening of the elative phrase, making the attachment audible, and the trustworthy city of 95:3 is answered by this move into structural soundness.

topics.headline: preposition marks created state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees best constitution as the state of creation itself, not as a later placement or independent object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence attaches {{ar:أَحْسَنِ}} ({{tr:aḥsani}}) through {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) to the creation verb as a state or setting complement.

topics.headline: within/as pressure stays inside state reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel both containment and inherence in the preposition while keeping the phrase grammatically tied to the created state.
topics.reason: The ambiguity is useful, but attachment evidence narrows it: the phrase is a state or setting complement, not a separate object or free-floating metaphor.

topics.headline: preposition pivots into the final quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse move from creator, act, and object into the resolving quality phrase.
topics.reason: The local order delays the prepositional phrase until after the object, and the preposition governs the elative construct as one constituent.

topics.headline: boundary sound and oath setting support attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition draw the closing phrase into one unit and can relate the secure oath setting to structural soundness.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows give local rhetorical payoff and do not alter the grammatical attachment.

words.gloss_range: elative/superlative construct head whose excellence is completed and localized by the following constitution noun
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, beauty, beneficent action, and excellence; local elative selects superlative value in the domain of constitution rather than every root branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: genitive complement completing the elative construct

words.prose: {{ar:أَحْسَنِ}} ({{tr:aḥsani}}) makes value arrive before the category being valued. As an elative in construct with {{ar:تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:taqwīmin}}), it is not a free-floating adjective; excellence is grammatically completed as constitutional excellence. The construct can be heard both as selecting the best from among possible constitutions and as naming the best kind of constitution, so the superlative is comparative in reach but locally anchored in the noun that follows. The word can hold beauty, goodness, and functional rightness together, with a narrowed actional pressure from the root's doing-well field, but the local form is an adjective, not a Form IV verb. Its superlative frame also prepares the later elative judgment language in 95:8, and the same local elative {{ar:أَحْسَنِ}} ({{tr:aḥsani}}) participates in the broader creator-excellence echo of 23:14, making excellence of making and excellence of constitution mutually audible without making that parallel control the local grammar. The nasal cadence at the end of the elative and in {{ar:تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:taqwīmin}}) reinforces the construct bond in sound as well as grammar.

topics.headline: superlative is locked to constitution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees excellence grammatically bound to constitution, not left as an abstract or standalone praise word.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:أَحْسَنِ}} ({{tr:aḥsani}}) as an elative/superlative adjective and attachment evidence makes it the construct head completed by {{ar:تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:taqwīmin}}).

topics.headline: best among constitutions or best kind of constitution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the phrase both as selecting the best from possible constitutions and as naming the best kind of constitution.
topics.reason: The construct with an indefinite genitive licenses the CRITICAL partitive and descriptive readings without requiring either to exclude the other.

topics.headline: beauty, goodness, and function converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the praise is aesthetic, moral, and functional at once, while still focused on the constituted human state.
topics.reason: V4 supports goodness/beauty and good-action branches, but the local elative adjective in construct narrows them to evaluative excellence in the domain of constitution.

topics.headline: surface overlap suggests perfecting, not a verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel actional perfecting behind the adjective while keeping the local word as a superlative, not a verbal form.
topics.reason: The local form tag is ADJ_COMP, so the Form IV overlap can color the root field but cannot change the word into a verb.

topics.headline: elative excellence echoes creation and judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the superlative of human constitution linked to divine making and later divine judgment without losing the local construct grammar.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete links to 95:8 and 23:14; these are valid echoes while the local syntax remains the governing evidence.

topics.headline: value precedes and binds the category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters the superlative judgment before the noun, then sees that judgment close around constitution.
topics.reason: The local word order places the elative before its genitive complement, and the construct relation makes the two words one closing phrase.

topics.headline: nasal cadence reinforces the construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the end of the elative and the following noun as a bound phrase, with the sound supporting the grammar.
topics.reason: The sound row and the 95:8 elative-frame row add local rhetorical payoff without changing the construct analysis.

words.gloss_range: Form II verbal noun of setting right, making stand, constitution, and appraisal, closing the phrase as an open-ended field of best human formation
words.root_gloss_range: broad q-w-m field of standing, establishing, maintaining, value, stature, people, and resurrection; the local Form II maṣdar selects active constitution while retaining narrowed uprightness and valuation pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct head whose excellence is completed by the noun

words.prose: {{ar:تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:taqwīmin}}) is the ayah's closing load-bearing word. As the genitive complement of {{ar:أَحْسَنِ}} ({{tr:aḥsani}}), it defines the field in which the superlative applies; as a Form II verbal noun, it keeps active setting-right and making-stand inside the result. The root {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) contributes uprightness, establishment, stature, and valuation, while more distant branches such as community, resurrection, timing, and collective identity are narrowed to semantic resonance rather than local sense. That resonance still matters: the individual constitution can be heard against the root's collective people-field, and the standing-day branch remains a secondary echo of a form made to stand again. Its indefiniteness leaves the scope of the best constitution open and magnified, and its final position makes the verse move from divine creating to achieved human constitution rather than from material source to shape. That closing uprightness then becomes the forward contrast for the descent of 95:5, while the word's rare local form makes the claim feel especially concentrated. The final -in cadence settles the assertion and answers the secure-city oath setting of 95:3 with a closing image of structural soundness.

topics.headline: verbal noun makes constitution active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final noun as an achieved act of setting right, not as a static shape label.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:taqwīmin}}) as a verbal noun, and V4 supports standing, establishing, and straightness branches that fit active constitution.

topics.headline: indefinite genitive completes the superlative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun both completes the construct and leaves the scope of excellence open-ended rather than fixed to a named template.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the noun the indefinite genitive second term of the construct governed through {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}).

topics.headline: uprightness and value thicken constitution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels physical uprightness, deliberate formation, and appraisal packed into the final constitution noun.
topics.reason: V4 supports upright standing, straightness, valuation, and stature branches, but the local Form II verbal noun narrows them into constitution rather than activating every q-w-m use.

topics.headline: wide q-w-m field remains resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that the final word belongs to a major standing-and-establishing field while not mistaking community, calendar, or resurrection branches for the local meaning.
topics.reason: The broad branches are accepted in V4, but the local word is a Form II gerund in an elative construct; distant branches survive only as resonance.

topics.headline: closing noun focuses on constitution, not material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verse end on what the human is made into rather than what material the human is made from.
topics.reason: The clause supplies an object and quality phrase but no material-source phrase, and the final noun specifies constitution.

topics.headline: rare form concentrates the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a broad root field is narrowed into a distinctive local noun for this unique claim.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence shows the gerund profile is relatively limited compared with the broad root field, matching the CRITICAL rarity and selection claims.

topics.headline: verse closes from act to result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the ayah from the creator's act to the formed constitution that completes the statement.
topics.reason: The local word order begins the predicate with the creation verb and ends the verse with the constitution noun completing the phrase.

topics.headline: upright constitution faces descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the best upright constitution in 95:4 set up the lowest-descent reversal in 95:5.
topics.reason: Attachment support connects the 95:4 object to 95:5, and the CRITICAL rows explicitly frame {{ar:تَقْوِيمٍ}} ({{tr:taqwīmin}}) as inverted by the following descent (95:5).

topics.headline: final cadence settles the assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final nasal cadence settle the oath answer and relate secure setting to sound human structure.
topics.reason: The cadence and boundary rows describe local rhetorical closure and do not claim a different lexical sense.

topics.headline: standing-day echo remains secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a secondary standing-and-goodness resonance without making resurrection the local referent of the noun.
topics.reason: V4 recognizes a resurrection branch for {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}), but local grammar selects constitution; the echo survives only as a secondary root-family resonance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Creation as measured proportion before any moral verdict.** Lexical evidence: خ ل ق B001, measuring/proportioning; خ ل ق B003, complete well-proportioned form; ح س ن B001, goodness/beauty opposed to ugliness; ق و م B008/B011, straightness and bodily stature. Structural cue: the ayah combines created human, best, and taqwim in a dense cluster of making, beauty, and uprightness. Assigned role: خلق supplies the act of measured making; حسن qualifies the quality; تقويم supplies upright measured stance. Abductive move: I infer that the oath sequence has been gathering witnesses to a standard by which the human's form can be called "best." Reading change: the ayah reads as a claim of calibrated proportion, not merely biological creation.

2. **Human presence as domestication against wildness and absence.** Lexical evidence: ء ن س B001, visible human presence against hidden/wild beings; ء ن س B003, familiarity removing estrangement; ط و ر B006 in 95:2, wildness beyond the domestic limit; ط و ر B007, no one present in a place. Structural cue: the word الإنسان stands after topographical signs and before a fall into lowliness. Assigned role: insan supplies the presence/familiarity pole, while ط و ر supplies the possible wild/empty opposite. Abductive move: I infer that "human" is not just species but the emergence of visible, social, familiar presence within a bounded world. Reading change: creation in best taqwim becomes the taming/presencing of a creature capable of social familiarity, not only anatomical excellence.

3. **Taqwim as uprightness, governance, and eventual court.** Lexical evidence: ق و م B002, bodily standing; ق و م B004, care/guardianship/governing; ق و م B008, straightness/uprightness; ق و م B013, resurrection/standing; ح ك م B002 in 95:8, judgment. Structural cue: تقويم is followed by الرد downward, then exception, then judgment. Assigned role: ق و م makes the human not only upright in body but placed under a regime of maintenance, straightness, and later standing-before-judgment. Abductive move: I supply the arrow that a formed uprightness implies accountability when later ayat ask about الدين and الحكم. Reading change: "best taqwim" becomes a legally and eschatologically loaded posture, not merely physical symmetry.

4. **Aptness for work and reward.** Lexical evidence: خ ل ق B005, worthiness/aptness; ع م ل B001/B008 in 95:6, intentional work and fitness for work; ء ج ر B001, recompense for work. Structural cue: the exception in 95:6 is phrased as believing and doing صالحات, followed by أجر. Assigned role: creation makes the human "fit" for the work/reward circuit that later distinguishes the exception. Abductive move: I infer that the created form is a capacity for accountable action, activated by the later عمل/أجر pair. Reading change: the ayah reads as enabling condition for responsible work, not only praise of original form.

5. **A shadow branch: fabricated speech threatens the created order.** Lexical evidence: خ ل ق B007, fabricating false speech; ك ذ ب B001/B002 in 95:7, falsehood and declaring false. Structural cue: after the creation claim and fall/exception, 95:7 asks what makes one deny. Assigned role: the same root خلق can move from divine proportioning to human fabrication when activated by يكذبك. Abductive move: I infer a contrast between God's measured making and the denier's invented counter-speech. Reading change: 95:4 becomes a standard against which denial looks like counterfeit making.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 95:8's أحكم was the biggest retrospective activator for 95:4. It echoes أحسن and makes "best taqwim" a measured standard that requires a best judge, not merely an admired form. 95:6 also made aptness-for-work unavoidable: خلق B005, عمل, صالحات, and أجر form a capacity-action-recompense chain. The surprising correction is that 95:4 is not only anthropology; it is the setup for a legal/accountable posture.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Calibrated, upright formation.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `خ ل ق/B001` supplies measuring and proportioning before an act, and `خ ل ق/B003` complete, balanced visible form; fixed `ح س ن/B001` supplies goodness or beauty against ugliness; fixed `ق و م/B008` supplies straightness and evenness, and `ق و م/B011` bodily stature and proportion. **Structural cue:** the construction places the human “in” the superlative *aḥsan* of *taqwīm*, immediately before the antithetical double low of 95:5. **Assigned role:** creation supplies measured production, *aḥsan* its optimal quality, and *taqwīm* its straight bodily and normative axis. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies compatible branches but no engineering metaphor; I infer that the phrase describes formation against a calibrated standard. **Reading change:** the ayah becomes a claim of deliberately proportioned uprightness, not generic creation followed by a free-standing compliment.

2. **A relational and civic capacity.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ء ن س/B003` supplies familiarity and companionship that remove estrangement; fixed `خ ل ق/B004` supplies inner disposition and moral bearing; fixed `ق و م/B004` supplies care, guardianship, maintenance, and governance. **Structural cue:** the created human is bracketed by the trustworthy city (95:3) and, later, trusting assent, sound deeds, and judgment among people (95:6–8). **Assigned role:** *insān* names relational presence, *khalq* an inward social disposition, and *taqwīm* the capacity to maintain an ordered common life. **Abductive move:** the packet does not define “best setting” as civic competence; I infer it because the human root’s anti-estrangement branch and the *q-w-m* maintenance branch become functional inside the surrounding trust-and-judgment sequence. **Reading change:** best formation includes the ability to sustain trustworthy relations and institutions, not bodily shape alone.

3. **Perceptual equipment that makes denial accountable.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ء ن س/B002` supplies perceiving or detecting by sight, hearing, or inward awareness. Later `ك ذ ب/B002` supplies declaring a report or person false (95:7), and `ح ك م/B003` supplies knowledge that reaches the truth (95:8). **Structural cue:** visible landscape markers fill 95:1–3; after the claim of human formation, 95:7 asks how falsification remains possible. **Assigned role:** the *insān* branch supplies the perceptual faculty by which the preceding signs can enter awareness. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies objects, perception, and the later challenge but does not say perception causes assent; I infer only that equipped awareness raises the evidentiary cost of denial. **Reading change:** “the human” is formed as a discerner, so *aḥsani taqwīm* has an epistemic dimension that grounds the later question.

4. **Formation as valuation before reckoning.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ق و م/B010` supplies value and appraisal, while `ق و م/B015` supplies exact, even weight; fixed `خ ل ق/B001` already supplies measurement. Later `ء ج ر/B001` names recompense for work, `د ي ن/B002` reckoning and recompense, and `ح ك م/B002` adjudication. **Structural cue:** measured creation precedes differentiated deeds, reward, reckoning, and a final comparison among judges. **Assigned role:** *taqwīm* is the initial appraisal or establishment of worth; later recompense tests action against that endowed measure. **Abductive move:** the packet gives the valuation vocabulary but no ledger; I infer a benchmark mechanism in which measured capacity makes later evaluation intelligible. **Reading change:** “best *taqwīm*” can denote conferred value and evaluability as well as straightening.

5. **An uprightness that can culminate in standing again.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ق و م/B013` supplies resurrection, the rising of the Hour, and people standing before their Lord. It is activated by later `ر د د/B001` return (95:5), `د ي ن/B002` reckoning (95:7), and the divine judge of 95:8. **Structural cue:** initial *taqwīm* is followed by descent, an exception with uncut reward, then reckoning and judgment. **Assigned role:** the resurrection branch makes upright standing the possible completion of the trajectory rather than only its starting posture. **Abductive move:** the packet does not explicitly state a second rising; I infer it from the accepted standing-before-the-Lord branch combined with return and adjudication. **Reading change:** the ayah’s upright formation acquires an eschatological horizon, so the downward turn need not be the human’s final state.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 95:5 first overturned a static reading of “best setting”: upright proportion became a reversible state on a vertical axis. The larger surprise came from 95:6–8, where work, recompense, reckoning, and judgment activated fixed `ق و م/B010`, `ق و م/B015`, and `ق و م/B013`; *taqwīm* retrospectively carried appraisal and possible standing-before-the-Lord, not anatomy alone.

baseline.text: Biz insanı gerçekten en iyi yapıda yarattık.

findings.text: Yaratılış, yalnızca bir beden kurmak değil, insanı ölçülü, dengeli ve dimdik bir standarda göre biçimlendirmektir.
İnsan adı, yabancılığı gideren tanışıklık ve birliktelik anlamıyla, en iyi yapının toplumsal ilişki kurma ve ortak düzeni sürdürme yeteneğini de içerdiğini gösterir.
İnsan, çevredeki yabani ve insansız alanın karşısında görünür, tanıdık ve yerleşik bir varlığın ortaya çıkışı olarak da belirir.
İnsan adı aynı zamanda görme, işitme ve içten sezme gücünü öne çıkarır; bu donanım, sonraki inkârı delil eksikliğinden çok sorumluluk sorunu hâline getirir.
Dimdik yapı, korunması ve yönetilmesi gereken bir doğruluk düzeni kurduğu için insanı sonraki hesap ve hüküm karşısında sorumlu bir konuma yerleştirir.
En iyi yapı, insana verilmiş değeri ve daha sonra davranışlarının tartılacağı kesin ölçüyü başlangıçtan kurar.
Bu yapı, insanı amaçlı çalışma ve bu çalışmanın karşılığını alma düzenine elverişli kılan bir yetkinliktir.
Dimdik kurulma, aşağı dönüşün ardından hesap için yeniden ayağa kalkma ihtimalini de taşır; ilk duruş böylece son duruşa açılır.
Yaratmanın uydurma söz anlamı, ilahi ölçülü yaratılışa karşı inkârı insanın ürettiği sahte bir karşı-yaratım gibi gösterir.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **95:4.** لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ — Birincil okuma: İnsan, ölçülmüş, dengelenmiş ve en güzel diklikte kurulmuş bir varlık olarak yaratılmıştır. Sonraki amel-ecir ve din-hüküm bağlantıları bu güzelliği yalnız bedensel biçim değil, sorumluluk taşıyan, çalışmaya elverişli ve sonunda en doğru hükme arz edilecek bir kıvam olarak değiştirir. {خ ل ق B001; خ ل ق B003; خ ل ق B005; ء ن س B001; ح س ن B001; ق و م B008; ق و م B013}
butuncul_okuma_line.arabic_text: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
butuncul_okuma_line.reading_text_tr: İnsan, ölçülmüş, dengelenmiş ve en güzel diklikte kurulmuş bir varlık olarak yaratılmıştır. Sonraki amel-ecir ve din-hüküm bağlantıları bu güzelliği yalnız bedensel biçim değil, sorumluluk taşıyan, çalışmaya elverişli ve sonunda en doğru hükme arz edilecek bir kıvam olarak değiştirir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.note: Completion of human form, spirit, and commanded recognition strongly expands formed human dignity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Emergence without knowledge followed by hearing, sight, and hearts directly clarifies responsible human faculties.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A measured form is brought into visible integrity, held upright, and remains liable to return and lowering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human proportion extends into the mechanics of standing, structural support, restoration, and directed descent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measured Human Formation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A human form is measured, created, completed, beautified, and set in rectitude.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: measured design `خ ل ق:B001/m01`, creative bringing-forth `خ ل ق:B002/m01`, completed visible form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`, human creature `ء ن س:B001/m01`, desirable beauty `ح س ن:B001/m01`, broad robust body `ب ل د:B008/m01`, rectitude and evenness `ق و م:B008/m01`, upright stature `ق و م:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Measurement precedes creation, creation resolves into a perceptible human figure, and beauty coincides with straightness and proportion. Broad bodily robustness and upright stature make the well-set form visible as both balanced outline and sustaining build.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A measured form is brought into visible integrity, held upright, and remains liable to return and lowering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human proportion extends into the mechanics of standing, structural support, restoration, and directed descent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Standing Support and Downward Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An upright body or structure is sustained, returned from its established state, and directed into a lower position.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bodily standing `ق و م:B002/m01`, structural support `ق و م:B009/m01`, return to a former state `ر د د:B001/m01`, directed descent `س ف ل:B004/m01`, lower position `س ف ل:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Standing supplies the initial stable configuration, while support explains how that configuration persists. Return and downward direction then form a single reversal process in which what stood is placed back into a lower state.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Making and Activating
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thing is manufactured, put into operation, and taken up as an active task.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: manufacture from material `خ ل ق:B002/m02`, operation and application `ع م ل:B002/m01`, rising to undertake an affair `ق و م:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Manufacture provides the object, application makes it operative, and rising to the affair supplies the active operator. Together they form a compact production-to-use sequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Compatible Replacement and Restoration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: One item stands in for another, fits its intended place, and restores the prior arrangement without delay.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: standing in another's place `ق و م:B007/m01`, replacement by another `غ ي ر:B003/m01`, return to owner or place `ر د د:B001/m02`, functional suitability `ص ل ح:B003/m01`, enactment without delay `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Substitution is not mere exchange: the replacement must fit the vacant function and be returned into the operative position. Immediacy closes the mechanism by preventing the restored function from remaining suspended.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exact and Beneficial Finish
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Work is completed with precision until it is secure, sound, and beneficial.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: exact workmanship `ح س ن:B002/m02`, secure finishing `ح ك م:B004/m01`, sound integrity `ص ل ح:B001/m01`, beneficial maintenance `غ ي ر:B001/m01`, fracture mended on a bend `ء ج ر:B002/m01`, absence of useful result `ب ع د:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Exact execution leads to a tightly secured and useful result. A fracture that heals crooked and an outcome with no benefit supply the contrary finish, distinguishing mere completion from sound, effective completion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Adjudication and Final Reckoning
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A measured case comes before judgment, receives an account, and culminates in the standing of resurrection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: adjudication between people `ح ك م:B002/m01`, reckoning and judgment `د ي ن:B002/m01`, resurrection and standing `ق و م:B013/m01`, prior estimation `خ ل ق:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Estimation frames the case, adjudication determines it, and reckoning gives the determination its consequence. Resurrection supplies the terminal scene in which those subject to judgment stand for the final account.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fabrication and Rejection
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A false account is manufactured, exposed, and refused like a defective or counterfeit item.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: falsehood opposed to truth `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`, fabricated speech `خ ل ق:B007/m01`, rejection of error or counterfeit `ر د د:B003/m01`, discrediting a speaker `ك ذ ب:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Fabrication gives falsehood the shape of a made object, while rejection treats it as something inspected and returned. The social act of discrediting the speaker completes the movement from manufactured claim to refused claim.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Penetrating and Defective Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sound discernment penetrates a matter, while weak opinion fails to reach or govern it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: right-reaching wisdom `ح ك م:B003/m01`, penetrating counsel `ب ع د:B008/m01`, weak opinion `ل ي س:B007/m01`, desirable goodness `ح س ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Penetrating counsel gives judgment depth, wisdom directs it toward the right result, and desirable goodness names its valued outcome. Weak opinion forms the reversal: a mind present to the matter but unable to penetrate it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The unending reward scene expands into labor markets, credit, pricing, equal weights, rescission, public office, bondage, and release without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Valuation and Equal Weight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Goods or liabilities are priced, weighed to an even standard, and converted into quantified compensation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: pricing and valuation `ق و م:B010/m01`, equal coin weight `ق و م:B015/m01`, measured quantity `م ن ن:B005/m01`, blood-money compensation `غ ي ر:B002/m01`, circulating market demand `ق و م:B018/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Valuation assigns an amount, equal weight stabilizes the unit, and measured quantity makes the amount transferable. Market circulation gives the unit an arena of exchange, while blood money extends quantified substitution from commodities to retaliation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The unending reward scene expands into labor markets, credit, pricing, equal weights, rescission, public office, bondage, and release without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Labor, Office, and Livelihood
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Workers perform manual or appointed service and receive the means by which life and social order are maintained.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: appointed public work `ع م ل:B003/m01`, manual workers `ع م ل:B006/m01`, livelihood and subsistence `ق و م:B009/m02`, wage `ء ج ر:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Manual labor and appointed office are two organized forms of service. Wage converts that service into livelihood, while the support sense of `ق و م` makes livelihood what keeps both body and social arrangement standing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Religious alignment is rendered as inward character, straightness, beneficial action, apostasy, divine favor, and the destructive social act of recounting a favor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Worship, Obedience, and Upright Disposition
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An inward character is oriented into worship, obedience, and straight conduct.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: worship and the worshipped one `ء ل ه:B001/m01`, obedience and religion `د ي ن:B001/m01`, inward disposition `خ ل ق:B004/m01`, moral straightness `ق و م:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Character supplies the inward formation, religion gives it an order of obedience, and worship directs it toward the divine. Straightness is the shared state in which inner disposition and enacted allegiance coincide.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Religious alignment is rendered as inward character, straightness, beneficial action, apostasy, divine favor, and the destructive social act of recounting a favor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Faith, Good Work, and Beneficence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Belief becomes intentional sound action and exceeds bare correctness through beneficence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: assent and faith `ء م ن:B002/m01`, intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`, rectitude in deed `ص ل ح:B001/m01`, beneficent action `ح س ن:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Faith supplies settled assent, work converts assent into action, and rectitude defines the action as sound. Beneficence carries the process beyond avoidance of فساد into active good done well.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Religious alignment is rendered as inward character, straightness, beneficial action, apostasy, divine favor, and the destructive social act of recounting a favor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Apostasy and Religious Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person reverses religious allegiance, leaving an upright order for its contrary.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: apostatic return `ر د د:B005/m01`, religious obedience `د ي ن:B001/m01`, straight alignment `ق و م:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Religious straightness supplies the initial alignment, while apostatic return gives reversal a specific social and doctrinal form. The same root that returns a thing to a prior state can therefore mark a departure from the adopted religious order.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Religious alignment is rendered as inward character, straightness, beneficial action, apostasy, divine favor, and the destructive social act of recounting a favor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Benefaction and Reproachful Reminder
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A favor creates trust and benefit, but repeated self-credit can burden the recipient and undo the social value of the gift.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: benefaction `م ن ن:B003/m01`, reproachful recounting `م ن ن:B003/m02`, generous good `ح س ن:B002/m03`, trust and security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Benefaction establishes a relation of good and security. Recounting the favor shifts the gift from benefit to pressure, producing a moral reversal in which speech after the act can destroy the act's social integrity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A place becomes intelligible through prominent terrain, named stations, residence, and the civic order maintained there.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The named landscape extends from mountains and towns into lunar stations, the noonday balance of the sun, civic obedience, and habitual residence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mountain and Named Landmark
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Mountains and named places organize a landscape into recognizable sacred or inhabited landmarks.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fig-associated mountain place `ت ي ن:B002/m01`, mountain landmark `ط و ر:B005/m01`, bounded tract of land `ب ل د:B001/m01`, named places `ص ل ح:B005/m01`, mountain or elevated body-name `ح س ن:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mountain, tract, and place-name cooperate as a geography of recognition. The same naming process moves between ordinary terrain and elevated landmarks, allowing a lexical mountain sense of the fig to join the explicit mountain and city sequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A place becomes intelligible through prominent terrain, named stations, residence, and the civic order maintained there.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The named landscape extends from mountains and towns into lunar stations, the noonday balance of the sun, civic obedience, and habitual residence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Celestial Station and Zenith
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The sky is partitioned into a lunar station, a named celestial body, and the balanced instant of solar noon.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lunar station and empty sky-place `ب ل د:B004/m01`, moon as a named beautiful body `ح س ن:B004/m02`, sun standing at noon `ق و م:B017/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: A bounded place migrates from earth to sky as a lunar station, while beauty names the visible celestial body. The sun's standing at the midpoint of the day supplies the scene's temporal and geometric balance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A place becomes intelligible through prominent terrain, named stations, residence, and the civic order maintained there.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The named landscape extends from mountains and towns into lunar stations, the noonday balance of the sun, civic obedience, and habitual residence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Residence, City, and Civic Obedience
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: People remain in a settled place whose identity depends on residence, assembly, and obedience to authority.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: settled residence `ب ل د:B009/m01`, station and dwelling `ق و م:B006/m01`, city organized by obedience `د ي ن:B006/m01`, remaining without departure `ل ي س:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Residence converts land into an inhabited station, prolonged remaining stabilizes it, and civic obedience gives the settlement an ordered political form. City is therefore both a place occupied and a relation maintained.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Entities are located by edges, near and far relations, facing and trailing sides, and movement across a lower or outer boundary.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Spatial language reaches from courtyards and distant places into spear anatomy, the human-facing side of an object, posteriority, and a lower bodily outlet.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Facing Side, Forepart, and Posteriority
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body or implement is oriented by the side facing a person, its working forepart, its lower line, and what comes behind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: human-facing inner side `ء ن س:B004/m01`, spear forepart `ع م ل:B009/m01`, posterior or subsequent position `ب ع د:B002/m01`, lower line `س ف ل:B001/m01`, leeward side `س ف ل:B003/m01`, aligned edge `ط و ر:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The human-facing side fixes orientation from the participant's viewpoint, while the spear's forepart supplies a functional front. Lower, leeward, and posterior positions complete a directional frame that works across bodies, tools, wind, and sequences.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human beings form provisioned groups structured by possession, labor, rank, kinship, protection, and intimate attachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The human collective includes manual workers and travelers, distant kin, low rank, penetrating counsel, protective jealousy, a returned woman, and the inward circle of confidants.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Provisioned Human Group
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A human group is identified by shared affiliation, manual work, travel, and provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: human collective `ء ن س:B001/m01`, people and men `ق و م:B001/m01`, attributed possessor or kin `ذ و و:B001/m01`, oil as group provision `ز ي ت:B004/m01`, manual workers `ع م ل:B006/m01`, travelers on foot `ع م ل:B012/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Human presence becomes a social group through affiliation and shared labor. Provision sustains the group, while hand-workers and foot-travelers show the collective in two recurrent modes: producing in place and moving together.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human beings form provisioned groups structured by possession, labor, rank, kinship, protection, and intimate attachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The human collective includes manual workers and travelers, distant kin, low rank, penetrating counsel, protective jealousy, a returned woman, and the inward circle of confidants.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Kinship, Return, and Protective Honor
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A woman returns to her family, and kinship organizes protection, jealousy, guarded closure, and their dishonorable absence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: distant kin `ب ع د:B005/m01`, returned or divorced woman `ر د د:B006/m01`, protective jealousy `غ ي ر:B004/m01`, guarded closure `خ ل ق:B012/m01`, dishonorable lack of jealousy `ل ي س:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Return places the woman back within her family network, where nearness and distance define responsibility. Protective jealousy and guarded closure express defense of that boundary, while the absence of jealousy marks its social inversion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human beings form provisioned groups structured by possession, labor, rank, kinship, protection, and intimate attachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The human collective includes manual workers and travelers, distant kin, low rank, penetrating counsel, protective jealousy, a returned woman, and the inward circle of confidants.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Companion, Confidant, and Inner Self
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Estrangement is removed by trusted company until the companion becomes an intimate, confidant, or figure for one's own self.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: companionship that removes estrangement `ء ن س:B003/m01`, intimate or chosen companion `ء ن س:B006/m01`, the self named as deceptive `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`, trust and security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Companionship first removes isolation, then narrows into the chosen intimate. The lexical self introduces an inward participant whose truthfulness is not guaranteed, so trust becomes the relation that holds intimacy together.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Capacity appears as the ability to approach without fear, fit an intended role, bear a load, and continue rather than lag or stop.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Familiar Presence Against Wild Absence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Human or tame presence occupies a place from which wildness, estrangement, or complete absence would otherwise withdraw.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: human presence `ء ن س:B001/m01`, tame familiarity `ء ن س:B003/m01`, wildness beyond human familiarity `ط و ر:B006/m01`, absence of anyone in the place `ط و ر:B007/m01`, wolf named `تينان` `ت ي ن:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Familiarity is spatial and social: a place is humanly occupied, a participant can be approached without hostility, and wildness marks movement beyond that relation. The named wolf supplies a concrete wild participant, while total absence is the limiting case in which no familiar participant remains.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Suitability and Immediate Readiness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A participant is predisposed to a task, fits its requirements, reaches the limit of effort, and acts without delay.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: predisposition and worthiness `خ ل ق:B005/m01`, functional suitability `ص ل ح:B003/m01`, utmost effort `ح س ن:B005/m01`, effortful exertion `ع م ل:B007/m01`, action without delay `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Predisposition supplies latent capacity, suitability aligns that capacity with a particular use, and exertion realizes it at the limit of effort. Immediacy marks completed readiness by eliminating hesitation between fitness and action.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Capacity appears as the ability to approach without fear, fit an intended role, bear a load, and continue rather than lag or stop.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Strength, Frailty, and Exhausted Halt
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body, rope, or working animal either possesses the strength to stand and continue or weakens until motion stops.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sustaining strength `م ن ن:B002/m01`, frailty of person or material `م ن ن:B002/m02`, bodily stature `ق و م:B011/m01`, stoppage through exhaustion `ق و م:B016/m01`, dull or lagging performance `ب ل د:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Stature supplies the standing frame, strength lets it persist, and frailty reduces its capacity. Lag and exhausted stopping are the observable outcomes when that supporting force fails.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Olives yield oil, a specialist presses or sells it, and the product becomes food provision within a group.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Extraction creates the product, specialized labor moves it into exchange, and provision carries it from seller to community. The oil is therefore simultaneously substance, commodity, and shared food.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A human image appears in the pupil, while an eye can retain its visible globe after vision has gone.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sensory perception by sight, hearing, or feeling `ء ن س:B002/m01`, reflected human in the pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`, intact but sightless eye `ق و م:B021/m01`, bodily surface mark `ب ل د:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Perception establishes the active sensory function and the pupil gives vision a visible miniature human image. The standing eye reverses that relation by preserving outward form after sight disappears, while the surface mark reinforces the distinction between what a body displays and what it can do.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A visible surface can display form, mark, polish, defect, decay, or ornament while concealing a different functional state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human beauty reaches into pupil reflections, an intact but blind eye, facial marks, worn cloth, deceptive ornament, polished ground contact, and sealed smoothness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Brow, Skin Mark, Beauty, and Facial Defect
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The visible face is read through openness between the brows, marks on skin, beauty, and a defect that mixes ugliness with remaining form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: clear space between the brows `ب ل د:B003/m01`, mark on skin or body `ب ل د:B006/m01`, facial or chin defect `ر د د:B008/m01`, visible beauty `ح س ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Brow spacing and skin marks make the face a legible surface, beauty supplies its positive valuation, and defect complicates that reading by combining impairment with remaining form.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A visible surface can display form, mark, polish, defect, decay, or ornament while concealing a different functional state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human beauty reaches into pupil reflections, an intact but blind eye, facial marks, worn cloth, deceptive ornament, polished ground contact, and sealed smoothness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Worn Cloth and Deceptive Ornament
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Cloth loses pile and integrity through wear, yet coloring or ornament can make its visible state misrepresent its actual condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: frayed and worn cloth `خ ل ق:B009/m01`, ornamented cloth that belies its state `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`, material frailty `م ن ن:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Wear reduces the material body of the cloth, frailty names its diminished resistance, and ornament supplies a contrary visual message. Appearance and integrity therefore move in opposite directions.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A visible surface can display form, mark, polish, defect, decay, or ornament while concealing a different functional state.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ground Contact, Smoothness, and Sealed Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body lies against the ground, is smoothed into an even surface, and may become solidly closed while bearing sustained contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: camel breast laid on the ground `ب ل د:B002/m02`, adhesion to the ground `ب ل د:B010/m01`, smooth even surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`, sealed solid closure `خ ل ق:B012/m01`, patient bearing `ل ي س:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The camel's breast and the adhering body establish sustained ground contact, smoothing removes irregularity, and sealed solidity gives the surface resistance. Forbearance carries the same invariant into conduct: remaining under pressure without opening, breaking, or reacting.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and implements remain serviceable through lower members, restraining fittings, handles, props, and load-bearing strength.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human and animal anatomy assembles with spear shafts, sword hilts, furniture legs, bridles, props, and the strength or weakness of a supporting rope.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lower Limbs and Leg Disease
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Lower limbs support an animal or object, perform work, and can be impaired by a disease that forces standing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: camel legs `س ف ل:B005/m01`, working limbs `ع م ل:B010/m01`, standing member or leg `ق و م:B012/m01`, disease in an animal's legs `ق و م:B020/m01`, pain established in an organ `ق و م:B019/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Legs are simultaneously lower parts, working organs, and standing supports. Disease and established organ pain reveal the mechanism by disrupting the same members on which posture and motion depend.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and implements remain serviceable through lower members, restraining fittings, handles, props, and load-bearing strength.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human and animal anatomy assembles with spear shafts, sword hilts, furniture legs, bridles, props, and the strength or weakness of a supporting rope.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Bridle, Spear Forepart, and Handle
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A handler orients and controls an implement or animal through a forepart, human-facing side, grip, and restraining fitting.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bridle around the jaws `ح ك م:B006/m01`, spear forepart `ع م ل:B009/m01`, human-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`, hilt or handle `ق و م:B012/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The human-facing side locates the handler, the handle transfers force, and the forepart directs it toward the task. The bridle completes the assembly by converting the handler's force into restraint.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and implements remain serviceable through lower members, restraining fittings, handles, props, and load-bearing strength.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human and animal anatomy assembles with spear shafts, sword hilts, furniture legs, bridles, props, and the strength or weakness of a supporting rope.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Prop, Load, Strength, and Collapse
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A prop or sustaining frame bears a load until weakness or exhaustion makes the supported body stop or fall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prop preventing collapse `ر د د:B009/m01`, structural support `ق و م:B009/m01`, sustaining strength `م ن ن:B002/m01`, frailty `م ن ن:B002/m02`, load-bearing capacity `ل ي س:B006/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The prop and standing support resist collapse, sustaining strength carries the imposed load, and load-bearing capacity describes the active bearer. Frailty is the failure mode in which that same assembly can no longer hold.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal life is organized through trained labor, bodily continuity, milk production, movement, and the protection of young.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human-centered roots disclose the trained work animal, the filling udder, milk that fails to last, an ostrich nest, young camels, and a wild animal that runs then stops to look back.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Trained Work Animal and Lagging Failure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An animal bred or habituated for work continues under load, while dullness, weakness, or exhaustion makes it lag and halt.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: animal formed for work `ع م ل:B008/m01`, lagging animal performance `ب ل د:B007/m02`, exhausted stopping `ق و م:B016/m01`, loss of strength `م ن ن:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Training gives the animal a stable work disposition, strength carries that disposition into motion, and lag exposes reduced aptitude. Exhausted stopping is the terminal state when the work capacity can no longer be sustained.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Processes unfold through ordered stages, return in intervals, or terminate when their duration, material, or force is cut.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Temporal order spans stages of creation, hesitation, intermittent meetings, action without delay, repeated oiling, exhausted travel, failing milk, and fraying cloth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Uncut Continuity and Material Cessation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Duration persists when uncut, but exhaustion, failed yield, or wear severs an ongoing process.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cutting or uninterrupted extension `م ن ن:B001/m01`, exhaustion that ends travel `م ن ن:B001/m02`, milk that does not persist `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`, cloth worn away through use `خ ل ق:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Uncut extension names continuity positively through the absence of severance. Exhaustion, vanishing milk, and worn cloth provide three concrete ways in which motion, yield, and material presence reach an end.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Confrontation, Settlement, and Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Opposing parties meet, reconcile their dispute, and submit the resulting settlement to judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: confrontation and resistance `ق و م:B014/m01`, reconciliation between people `ص ل ح:B002/m01`, adjudication `ح ك م:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Confrontation supplies the opposed parties, reconciliation removes estrangement, and adjudication gives the agreement an authoritative form. The scene turns conflict into an ordered social relation rather than merely ending motion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life regulates opposition through confrontation, negotiated settlement, adjudication, office, custom, and governance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The peaceful and judicial frame extends into sword combat, wrestling resistance, the truth or failure of a charge, public office, habitual rule, and civic stewardship.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Combat and the Truth of a Charge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Combatants resist one another with weapons, and a charge is judged by whether the attacker carries it through or falters.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sword or staff combat `ب ل د:B011/m01`, resistance in combat `ق و م:B014/m01`, far-reaching hostility `ب ع د:B010/m01`, committed charge `ك ذ ب:B004/m01`, faltering charge `ك ذ ب:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hostility carries opposition into the encounter, armed combat gives it an instrument, and resistance holds the opponents against one another. The charge then tests resolve in motion: its truth is enacted by completion and its falsehood by stopping short.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life regulates opposition through confrontation, negotiated settlement, adjudication, office, custom, and governance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Office, Custom, and Civic Stewardship
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An appointed official maintains a settled community through recurring office, customary order, and active stewardship.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: public appointment `ع م ل:B003/m01`, governance and stewardship `ق و م:B004/m02`, habitual order `د ي ن:B005/m01`, settled residence `ب ل د:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Settlement supplies the governed setting, office assigns responsibility, custom stabilizes repeated conduct, and stewardship keeps the arrangement functioning over time.
